settings.heading: Cooking Made Simpler
settings.text: Brisk It makes your cooking experience simpler with the power of AI.

settings.heading: Tell Brisk It What You Need
settings.text: Health goals, cravings, or a photo of your ingredients — Brisk It AI learns it all and builds a recipe around you.

settings.heading: Prep with AI-Powered Guidance
settings.text: Smart ingredients, prep steps, and cooking instructions are laid out for you. Brisk It guides your every move.

settings.heading: Let Full-Self Cooking Take Over
settings.text: Place your food on the device. Brisk It monitors, adjusts, and controls heat in real time — from ignition to perfect doneness.

settings.heading: Juggling life? AI adapts, so you don’t have to.
settings.text: AI is constantly monitoring your grill and adapting to unexpected events to make sure that nothing is overcooked or ruined.

settings.heading: Brisk It AI Learns With Every Cook.
settings.text: Brisk It AI learns your preferences and cooking behavior, optimizing future cooks and creating new, relevant recipes for you to try.
